413-643-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
413-643-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

1086-1981-2415-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

261-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

129-1409-1879-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1251-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-1251-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-1251-3443.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

2079-2590-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

1477-2700-6972.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

431-851-1308-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1308-3129.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

560-1496-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-1496-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2034-2820-4679-4927.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

703-4050-4192-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

4067-5042-6254-6480.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Rescue Leopard.
Rescue Leopard triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rescue Leopard.
Repeat.

222-527-955-3967.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-955-3967.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2713-3128-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Skullport Merchant.
When Skullport Merchant enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1267-4600-5658.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-4600-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker.
Satya triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of Medomai the Ageless, and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Deal combat damage using the Medomai the Ageless token.
The Medomai the Ageless token triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Medomai the Ageless token.
Repeat each turn.

1963-3003-4432.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six artifacts.
1963-3003-4432.description:
Cast Leashling by paying {0}.
When Leashling enters the battlefield, Garruk's Packleader triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Leashling by putting a card from your hand on top of your library, returning Leashling to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

776-1329-1540-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1540-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Chalice of the Void to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Chalice of the Void.
Cast Chalice of the Void.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
